shots.what_happens: Real product capture shown while the line 'agent locally, ... zap it back up onto the cloud when you want to let it work on its own' plays (w181-w207). It opens framed tightly on a chat with the cursor clicking 'Move to Local'. Next it shows the full window with the Changes pane (PR #89985, 7 files changed, diffs). Around 0:48 a tighter framing shows a right-click context menu on a sidebar agent, where 'Move to' opens a submenu with '/Users/eric/dev/site' and 'Cloud', and the cursor moves to 'Cloud'. The menu then closes on the chat ('Here's what changed:'). The framing changes inside the shot look like digital punch-ins or reframes, but at 2 fps I cannot tell whether they are animated zooms or cuts the detector missed.
shots.build_rebuild: Screen-record the real app at high resolution, then in the edit punch in (scale about 1.5-2x around the cursor) on the 'Move to Local' button and later on the context menu 'Move to > Cloud' submenu, pulling back to the full window in between so the menu items stay legible.

shots.typography: Native app UI type: a neutral system sans (possibly SF Pro, low confidence), sentence case, regular body with bold headings ('Walkthrough', 'Summary', 'Testing'), monospace for paths and commands, small pill-button labels, normal tracking. No added motion-graphics type.
shots.what_happens: Un-zoomed full-window capture under the line 'Zen state where you're interacting with all these different agents that are running on different machines. We' (w230-w246). The cursor hops through about five sidebar agents roughly every 0.5-1.5 s. Each click swaps the chat pane: a migration plan, an artifact request with an embedded video card, 'Record a demo' with two playable video cards ('Slash Menu Smoketest Xvfb Demo', 'Slash Menu Actions Section Smoketest Demo'), and finally a running agent showing 'Thought briefly' step lines and a spinner in the sidebar. At 2 fps most body text is too small to read; I quoted only text that is legible on the keyframe.
shots.build_rebuild: Record one continuous full-window capture of real parallel agents and click a different sidebar item on roughly every second beat, so the main pane swaps instantly and shows variety (plans, video artifacts, a live run) without any zoom.
